definition: Extremely hateful or offensive, especially for moral reasons.
author: Herman Melville
quote: That ghastly whiteness it is which imparts such an abhorrent mildness, even more loathsome than terrific, to the dumb gloating of their aspect.
example_sentence: She found cruelty to animals abhorrent.
